Alex: heads up — after flipping the FP8+INT4 mix for the low-latency config we saw a steady token-latency regression on a subset of traffic. initial deploy at 08:04 UTC.
Maria: which models / instances?
Alex: mostly gpt-medium+quantized on A100p4. batch size distribution skewed toward 1-4 as usual. overall throughput similar but p50/p95 moved.
Cheng: can you paste perf numbers?
Alex: sure, quick snapshot from /opt/prof/run-2026-03-16.log:
```
# baseline (fp16 compilation): avg_token = 18.9 ms, p95 = 46 ms
# fp8-int4 experimental: avg_token = 24.6 ms, p95 = 73 ms
# throughput drop ~17% for short prompt workloads
```
Maria: ugh. that's not small. any regression triggers in the kernel-selection logs?
Alex: looked at the routing trace — when KV hotness is high we fall back to a CUTLASS INT4 kernel with slower epilogue path for alignment mismatches. the selection heuristic favored the fp8 kernel earlier, but calibration changed quant scale, so prober now picks different kernels for ~30% of requests.
Priya: is this the calibration-driven threshold we added in last week's commit? (#repo commit 8f3b)
Alex: yes, the calibration change adjusted per-layer scale multiplicatively; some heads got clipped -> different kernel codegen due to perf-model thresholds.
Cheng: can you dump the kernel selection decision for an example request?
Alex: pasted an anonymized decision trace below:
```
[trace] model=gpt-medium quant_mode=auto calib_profile=2026-03-15
requested_seq=64 batch=2 kv_hot=true
arch=sm80 reported
probe_scores: fp8_fast=0.43 int8_cutlass=0.67 int4_cutlass=0.82
chosen=int4_cutlass fallback=fp8_fast
reason: perf_model_estimate (kv_alignment_penalty + epilogue_overhead)
```
Maria: int4_cutlass score > fp8_fast because of estimated L2 thrash on kv-blocks?
Alex: exactly. profiler shows extra memcpy and alignment fixup in int4 path adding ~4-7ms per token for short sequences. for longer seqs the throughput crossover still favors int4.
Priya: so regression is workload-shape dependent. Can we tweak the heuristic to prefer fp8 for batch<=4 + kv_hot?
Cheng: we should be careful — fp8 path has slightly worse quality on some calibration sets. what's the eval delta?
Alex: quick eval on our calibration set: Rouge/Perp differences negligible for this model (delta <1%). For translator-style prompts we see occasional artefacts but those are <0.5% of outputs.
Maria: propose a quick A/B: route 20% of batch<=4 kv_hot to fp8 kernel and collect token-latency + regression alerts.
Priya: SGTM. also add an instrumentation flag to log kernel_name + perf_est in route decisions (dev-only, sample 1%).
Cheng: also check compiler flags — were we building CUTLASS with -DTRITON_USE_CUTLASS=1 and the new CUTLASS_4BIT_EPILOGUE enabled? I remember a recent change that altered memory layout for small tensors.
Alex: build flags in this run: 
```
CMAKE_ARGS="-DTRITON=1 -DUSE_CUTLASS=ON -DCUTLASS_4BIT_EPILOGUE=ON -O3"
kernel toggles: CUTLASS_INT4 enabled, CUTLASS_FP8 optimized path enabled
arch detection: runtime reported sm80, but we had a fallback that treats sm86 as sm80 for now
```
Maria: can we repro locally on l40? arch mismatch might be playing a role.
Alex: tried on L40 devbox: no regression there. suspect A100 L3/L2 behaviors differ; alignment penalties heavier on A100p4 due to microcode.
Cheng: next actions: (1) enable A/B routing to route small batches to fp8 (Maria), (2) collect detailed kernel decision + prof counters (Priya), (3) run a CUTLASS compile with EPILOGUE_DEBUG logging to see alignment fixups (Cheng), (4) add a short-term heuristic tweak to penalize alignment penalty less aggressively for batch<=4 (Alex).
Priya: I'll add the sampled logging flag to prod config now: `kernel.selection.log_sample_rate=0.01` and `kernel.selection.debug=true` for the A/B cohort.
Maria: timeline? can we get initial A/B signals in 6 hours?
Alex: I'll push the routing change in canary in ~30m, collect data for 6 hours, then report back.
Cheng: if A/B looks good, we should also add an offline calibration sweep that checks per-layer scale variance and marks layers with high variance as "sensitive" to prefer fp8 for safety.
Priya: noted. I'll add an eval job in the pipeline.
DevBot: deploy-canary: succeeded for canary cluster r-infer-04 at 08:36 UTC :white_check_mark:
Alex: canary pushed. watching the dashboards. :eyes:
Maria: thanks — please paste any traces that look anomalous. we'll fold findings into the kernel prober RFC if needed. :thumbsup:
Priya: preliminary stats after 45m: in A/B, cohort routed to fp8 shows avg_token 19.6ms vs control 24.1ms. p95 improved 20%.
Alex: nice. continuing to monitor.
Maria: great, keep the change scoped to batch<=4 for now and let's not flip the default until we get 24h of signals.
Alex: agreed. will post final summary tomorrow morning.
Priya: FYI I'll open a short PR to add the sampled decision logging and a unit test for alignment estimation math.
Cheng: cool. thanks team.
Alex: thanks all.
